item.title: Pinterest Replaces Journey Clustering with 4B Qwen3 LLM, Reports Improved Engagement
item.description:
Pinterest has moved its user-journey inference system from a multi-stage clustering pipeline to a fine-tuned 4-billion-parameter language model, reporting a 1.1% improvement in email click-through and 1.3% higher push opens.

By Matt Foster

item.title: Entire's Git Forge Rethinks Git Collaboration for Coding Agents
item.description:
Entire is a Git forge designed specifically for collaboration between human developers and AI coding agents. Its premise is that traditional software development infrastructure, particularly the pull request (PR) model, is not well suited to an environment where AI agents generate, review, and iterate on code at high speed.

By Sergio De Simone

item.title: Google Cloud Adds Self-Managed VMware Cloud Foundation on Bare Metal
item.description:
Google Cloud has made a self-managed VMware solution generally available, running VMware Cloud Foundation 9.x on dedicated Z3 bare metal with root access across ESXi, vCenter and NSX in 22 regions. It sits beside the Google-managed VMware Engine and matches customer-operated offerings from AWS and Oracle, shifting lifecycle, patching and Broadcom licensing back to the customer.

By Steef-Jan Wiggers

item.title: Cloudflare Scales D1 Control Plane to Millions of Databases
item.description:
In a recent article, Cloudflare shared the redesign of the control plane of its D1 serverless SQL database to support millions of databases, avoiding centralized bottlenecks, implementing retries and idempotency, and using eventual consistency.

By Renato Losio
